name: syft
why: SBOM-1: the one open-source SBOM generator the release workflow runs, for the Windows runner that cuts a release. tools/New-VmfSbom.ps1 downloads this file, refuses it unless its sha256 is this one, and refuses a program that does not report this version. The sha256 is the one the release's own checksums file gives. SBOM-GEN-DRIFT-1: the daily drift check reports a newer release, and a GitHub advisory against this version (tools/Test-VmfPartPinDrift.ps1, from the pinnedElsewhere entry in infra/part-versions.json). To move it: read the release notes, then run ./tools/Test-VmfPartPinDrift.ps1 -UpdateBaseline -Part generator:anchore/syft, which changes version, releaseNotes, url and sha256 together, takes the sha256 from that release's checksums file, and refuses a file whose sha256 is not that one.
